title: Bimetric gravity with explicit matter coupling on fresh joint dynamics and lensing data
hypothesis: A single stable interacting two-metric system with one frozen baryonic matter coupling predicts both stellar motion and Einstein-radius lensing better than baryon-only GR and ordinary photometric nuisance models on fresh strong lenses.

discovery_policy.universal_gravity_track: Require one unchanged bimetric action-adjacent rule and universal parameter cell to pass joint dynamics, lensing, stability, locality, broad-slice, and later cross-scale gates.
discovery_policy.phenomenon_publication_track: Retain any reproducible held-out metric-mixing, screening, or regime relation that beats ordinary controls on its actual domain even if it is not a complete gravity theory.

theory.action: S=m_g^2 int sqrt(-g)R[g]+m_f^2 int sqrt(-f)R[f]-2m^4 int sqrt(-g) sum_n beta_n e_n(sqrt(g^-1 f))+S_m[g_eff,psi]
theory.effective_matter_metric: g_eff=alpha^2 g+2 alpha beta g sqrt(g^-1 f)+beta^2 f
theory.mass_basis: Around f=c^2 g, diagonalize metric perturbations into one massless spin-2 mode G and one Fierz-Pauli massive spin-2 mode M with matter-angle mismatch delta=chi-theta.
theory.massive_residue: A=(4/3) tan(delta)^2 is nonnegative for positive kinetic norms; the factor 4/3 is absorbed into the nonrelativistic massive-mode strength.
theory.light_projection: The static Fierz-Pauli massive pole contributes 3/4 as much to null deflection as to nonrelativistic acceleration after the same local Newton normalization.
theory.linear_equivalence: Every proportional-background linear candidate is exactly a massless plus massive pole and is a known behavioral rewrite of Items 19 and 21, regardless of whether matter couples to g alone or to g_eff.
theory.nonlinear_branch_equation: u+c3*u^2+c4*u^3=x with x=(rV/r)^3; c3>=0 and c4>0 make the nonnegative solution unique, and S_V=u/x tends to one when unscreened and to zero at short distance.
theory.branch_exchange: The matter/mass-eigenstate angle mismatch changes universally with baryon-predicted acceleration: delta(a)=delta_outer*[1+(q-1)/(1+(a_t/a)^p)].
theory.observable_response: mu_D=(1+A(a) S_V Y)/(1+A_solar S_V_solar Y_solar), mu_L=(1+0.75 A(a) S_V Y)/(1+A_solar S_V_solar Y_solar), Y=(1+r/lambda)exp(-r/lambda).

literature.label: de Rham-Heisenberg-Ribeiro effective composite matter metric
Schmidt-May mass eigenstates and proportional-background GR degeneracy

claim_limits: The nonlinear static interpolation is derived from a monotone decoupling-limit branch equation but is not an exact galaxy solution of the full Hassan-Rosen equations.
The composite matter metric is treated as an effective coupling below its cutoff; no all-scale ghost-free completion is claimed.

Positive kinetic norms, positive Fierz-Pauli mass squared, unique monotone branch response, positive observables, and a Solar-System bound are enforced; gradient, radiation, cosmology, and full Hamiltonian constraints remain later gates.

sources.identity_paper: Sonnenfeld et al., A&A 642, A148 (2020), SuGOHI VI

observable_lineage.baryons: Extinction-corrected Legacy DR9 Tractor r/z model flux and half-light geometry; one z-band mass-to-light offset is fit on training folds only.
observable_lineage.dynamics: SDSS DR16 spectroscopic stellar velocity dispersion is opened only for frozen exploration coordinates.
observable_lineage.lensing: The official SuGOHI master list Einstein radius is opened only for frozen exploration coordinates and used as an evaluation radius, never as a candidate feature.

sample.role_rule: Sort the 15 quality-eligible lenses by lens redshift into three fixed groups of five, seal the lowest HMAC role rank in each group, and assign the 12 remaining identities by HMAC rank to four folds of three.
sample.identity_normalization: survey-independent JHHMMSS+DDMMSS coordinate core plus a three-arcsecond predecessor-coordinate veto

candidate_generator.algorithm: numpy.random.Generator(PCG64) with four exactly balanced mechanism niches before stability and local filters

niches.behaviorally_equivalent_to: the same two-pole response, including a GR-degenerate delta=0 boundary

equivalence_boundaries: Both linear niches are structurally the same healthy massless-plus-massive pole family already certified in Item 21; a different matter-coordinate label does not make them new.
The composite proportional branch becomes exactly GR at delta=chi-theta=0; zero is represented by the synthetic GR control rather than duplicated across the random library.
The nonlinear branch counts as non-equivalent only because its source-dependent algebraic solution cannot be removed by one global linear field redefinition.
The branch-exchange niche collapses to the nonlinear branch when the inner/outer angle ratio is one; one is deliberately not sampled.
Historical novelty is never inferred from algebraic non-equivalence and requires a separate literature audit.
